method: Native 1024x1024 candidate and 600x600 game-scale review; in-engine 1024x1024 GL Compatibility capture separately inspected.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Enemy visibly carries a torch, not a modern firearm or ranged weapon.
acceptance_checks.notes: The right-hand rogue holds a short haft with a metal cage and flame; no firearm silhouette, barrel, stock, trigger or sight is visible.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Purple Haze is a low extended area cloud covering substantial ground and has layered readable edges.
acceptance_checks.notes: Broad, scalloped violet smoke occupies the lower foreground and wraps around/under the rogue; density reads as a persistent zone rather than the old small detached puff.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Both figures, held props, contact/attack pose and route remain readable.
acceptance_checks.notes: Hero lantern, rogue torch and both body silhouettes remain legible through translucent cloud. The cloud overlaps the rogue lower legs and parts of route; exact wind-up/action tell and foot contact are not fully clear.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Keep palette, painterly treatment, environment motif and camera consistent in intent.
acceptance_checks.notes: Blue-slate ruined arch, ember pinpoints, painted surfaces, left/right staging and elevated three-quarter view are retained. Generation is not reference-conditioned; specific architecture/poses/details vary.

strengths: Torch compliance is corrected: the opposing rogue has an unmistakable burning lantern/cage torch.
Haze reads as broad ground-occupying area control with softly layered edges rather than a small airborne puff.
Slate-blue archway environment, warm fire and violet focal contrast remain coherent; both characters remain visible at the review scale.
remaining_defects: Haze blankets portions of the path and the rogue lower legs; tactical-foot placement/route clarity is only partial.
Rogue pose reads more like a planted guard/torch display than an unmistakable committed wind-up despite the torch being correct.
Hero lantern and rogue torch designs/identity are independently generated; they are not locked to the existing protagonist reference or each other.
This remains one opaque scenic illustration and a label overlay, not separated/modular sprites, live smoke, animation, control, collision, combat, or gameplay.
Only an elevated composition was revised. No new matched side-on runtime composition exists; camera decision remains open.
decision: Promote revision 02 over candidate 01 only as a reference/style candidate for torch-bearing enemy and Haze field scale; do not promote as approved game art. It resolves the two targeted prompt defects but leaves legibility and semantic-action issues to iterate in an actual playable proof.

gate_state.artifact_valid: 1024x1024 RGB PNG; SHA-256 verified against generation receipt
